# Generated contracts (do not edit)

Files in `generated/` are produced by `pnpm contracts:gen`:

- `zod/rest.zod.ts` — REST zod schemas generated by orval from `openapi.json`
- `client/rest.ts` — REST fetch client, request/response types and model
  interfaces generated by orval
- `ws.d.ts` — WebSocket envelope, payload and host-message types generated from
  `ws.schema.json`
- `tools.d.ts` — tool contract types generated from `tools.schema.json`

Edit only the Pydantic models under `apps/server/app/contracts/`; CI fails when
regeneration produces a diff (PRD §5.6). The frontend imports generated types
directly (`import type { SceneDocument } from './generated/client/rest'`) and
keeps only a thin error-handling wrapper in `src/api/client.ts`.
